title: Abbas se kehna hai
body:
ay ishq e hussaini mujhe aejaz dikha de
tu meri aqeedat ka mujhe aisa sila de
ek baar mujhe khwaab mein ghazi se mila de
jo baat hai is dil mein wo sarkar se kehna hai
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas se kehna hai abbas se kehna hai
abbas se kehna hai alamdar se kehna hai
abbas se kehna hai
ghazi alamdar e wafa ghazi alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas se kehna hai ke tum shaah e wafa ho
tum sheh ke alamdar sakina ke chacha ho
aur saare muhibbon ke liye dast e ata ho
abbas ghulami ki sanad aap se lena hai
abbas se kehna hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo shaan e alamdar wohi shaan e alam hai
dono hi hamare hai ye maalik ka karam hai
maula ye alam aap ka ham sab ka bharam hai
hum ko to alam ke hi sada saaye mein rehna hai
abbas se kehna hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum baab e hawaij ho waseela ho hamara
aata hai muraade liye chaukhat pe zamana
haa dar se tumhare koi khaali nahi jaata
allah se maanga hai magar tum ne dilana hai
abbas se kehna hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham koi bhi jab dil ko hamare hai satata
jab koi kada waqt kabhi hum pe hai aata
abbas alam aap ka himmat hai badhata
dil toote to toota hua dil tum ko bulata hai
abbas se kehna hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sayeen mere sarkar mere murshid o maula
is baar moharam mein ho mera bhi bulawa
likhwado mera naam bhi zawwaro mein aaqa
ro ro ke tumhe nauha sakina ka sunana hai
abbas se kehna hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo jo bhi sitam baad e alamdar hua hai
sadaat ne pardes mein jo zulm saha hai
har mod pe zainab ne yehi ro ke kaha hai
is dil pe jo guzri hai kisi se nahi kehna hai
abbas se kehna hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas se kehna hai ke ghar aao na maula
tum apni ziyarat hamein karwao na maula
ek tohfa tumhara hai wo le jao na maula
pani se bhari mashk sakina tumhe dena hai
abbas se kehna hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas mere rab ka anmol waseela hai
mashoor zamane mein saqqa e sakina hai
har toote huwe dil ka abbas waseela hai
ye baab e hawaij hai har gham ka madawa hai
har lab ka wazeefa hai har dil mein dhadakta hai
girton ko uthaata hai doobo to bachata hai
taqdeer jagaata hai qismat ko sajaata hai
abbas se kehna hai abbas se kehna hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hasnain ka sadqa do abbas se kehna hai
jholi ko meri bhar do abbas se kehna hai
mushkil meri hal kar do abbas se kehna hai
parcham ki hawa dedo abbas se kehna hai
rauze pe bula bhejo zawwari ata kar do
maula ye karam kar do
abbas se kehna hai mujhe abbas se kehna hai
author: N. Sarwar & J. Jaffri
